en.label: Numeric orientation 1
en.definition: PHI OS canonical number-orientation semantic slot NO01. The slot records role-scoped numeric structural correspondence only. It does not define personality, life purpose, capability, destiny or future outcome.

zh-Hans.label: 数字方向 1
zh-Hans.definition: PHI OS canonical 数字方向语义槽位 1。该槽位只记录特定角色中的数字结构对应；它不定义人格、人生目的、能力、命运或未来结果。
